# cloudflare-workers-static-site

Deploy a static site (Astro, Vite, Hugo, Eleventy, plain HTML) from a GitHub repo to Cloudflare Workers static assets, with GitHub Actions doing build, check and deploy on push to main. Use when a repo or monorepo subfolder holds a static or mostly static site that should go live on Cloudflare, or when moving a site off Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Do NOT use for Cloudflare Pages (`wrangler pages deploy`) or for server-rendered apps that need a framework adapter.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r cloudflare-workers-static-site ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r cloudflare-workers-static-site .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `templates/_headers`
- `templates/deploy.yml`
- `templates/worker.ts`
- `templates/wrangler.assets-only.jsonc`
- `templates/wrangler.with-worker.jsonc`
